grouping.denominator_rule: abs(r_P)>=0.05 inclusive; otherwise epsilon NaN and DENOMINATOR_UNRESOLVED
grouping.epsilon_policy: finite nonnegative; no sign transformation or new truncation
grouping.feature_definition: independent per-T mean and population SD

support_rule.selection: Silhouette>=0.25, no single-code clusters, median perturbation ARI>=0.75, P10 ARI>=0.50. Among eligible cuts within0.02 silhouette of best, choose smallest K. Otherwise T_GROUP_POOLED_FALLBACK.
support_rule.bootstrap: 20 date-block resamples per T, seed42; same dates weighted across codes
support_rule.date_subset: alternating chronological dates; also exclude codes with<5 dates

grouping.clustering_method: deterministic average linkage sorted raw codes
grouping.cluster_selection_rule: Silhouette>=0.25, no single-code clusters, median perturbation ARI>=0.75, P10 ARI>=0.50. Among eligible cuts within0.02 silhouette of best, choose smallest K. Otherwise T_GROUP_POOLED_FALLBACK.

stability_rule.selection: Silhouette>=0.25, no single-code clusters, median perturbation ARI>=0.75, P10 ARI>=0.50. Among eligible cuts within0.02 silhouette of best, choose smallest K. Otherwise T_GROUP_POOLED_FALLBACK.
stability_rule.bootstrap: 20 date-block resamples per T, seed42; same dates weighted across codes
stability_rule.date_subset: alternating chronological dates; also exclude codes with<5 dates

levels: same raw weather code pooled across T
fallback_policy.ungroupable_T: Explicit T_GROUP_POOLED_FALLBACK bypasses raw-weather fallback to avoid reintroducing unsupported weather separation within that T
fallback_policy.rationale: No permanent behavioural group exists across T; weather-only means same raw code, not union of changing cluster memberships.

grouping.minimum_runtime_epsilon: positive required by unchanged inverse-epsilon threshold; observed zero count0

observation_unit: Bin elasticity with probability proportional to eligible historical request count; represents observed trip-distance mixture, not identified individual heterogeneity
support_rule: Positive finite bin estimates; inclusive empirical minimum/maximum per pool. No magnitude transform or extra near-zero floor.
exclusions: Negative/zero/nonfinite estimates retained in diagnostic CSV; excluded only from positive sampler, no trip deletion.
reference_status: Existing references retained provisionally; master reference selection not resolved
open_decisions: Continuous-weather feature alignment and decision-time availability
fallback: Existing historical >=5000 trip-candidate support rule and ordering; not evidence of 5000 independent bin estimates
support_limitation: January-February versus March1-15 support exceedance remains diagnostic; no bounds widened using held-out bins. This contract reuses the explicitly authorized Jan1-Mar15 calibration population, not a train-only evaluation model.
